about: Days of the gap-down study for tools/gapdown/test_ebd.py: the stock at the last close, the Earnings tab's row, the day's 1-minute bars [minute after 9:30, open, high, low, close, volume] and what the earnings breakdown alert did on the minute-by-minute replay (tools/gapdown/sim_ebd.py).

cases.note: a tight, strong one that worked all day
alerted, then stopped at the candle's high
lost the low, back under it: BACK ON
broke the low and was back at the candle's high before a check: no alert
a late open: the candle it opened in
a wick under the low, never under it at a check: no alert
a 12%+ gap-down without earnings: no alert
earnings, but the gap under 8%: no alert
